verdict.rationale: LanceDB documents explicit row-level deletion via predicates (table.delete("role = 'Traitor Knight'")) and versioning/time-travel for audit trails, giving users some control over data lifecycle. However, there is no documented retention-policy mechanism (e.g., TTL, automatic expiry, GDPR-style right-to-erasure workflow across all versions/branches) beyond manual delete calls. missing for 10: documented retention/TTL policy features, evidence that deletion purges historical versions/branches (vs. just current snapshot), independent confirmation of deletion behavior.
